title: Feed A Crowd: Curried Bean 'Chapati' Tacos
subtitle: Cook Once, Serve More!
description: Serve up more with our Feed A Crowd recipes! Using more hearty ingredients like filling carbs, proteins and veggies, you can satisfy extra hungry tummies or keep something for tomorrow’s lunch. If you’re on a 2-person plan, these recipes make 4 portions; on a 4-person plan, they make 8 portions.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Finely chop the onion. Finely chop the cucumber. Crush or finely chop the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans.

Make toppings: To make the raita, combine the vegan sour cream, half the cucumber and 2 tsp water in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. To make the salsa, combine the remaining cucumber, half the onion and 1½ tsp white wine vinegar in a separate bowl and season with salt and pepper.

Soften onion: Heat 1 tbs vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the remaining onion, stirring, for 3 mins or until softened. Add the garlic, tomato paste and masala seasoning (see Make it yours) and cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant.

Simmer curried beans: Preheat the grill to high. Add the beans and 250ml (1 cup) water to the onion mixture and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Cook, stirring, for 5 mins or until thickened. Stir in 1 tsp sugar and 1½ tsp white wine vinegar. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Serve up: Meanwhile, to make the 'chapati', put the tortillas on a large oven tray (don't worry if they overlap slightly). Grill the tortillas for 1 min each side or until warmed through and lightly charred. Divide the 'chapati' among plates. Fill with the curried beans, spinach, cucumber salsa and vegan raita. Enjoy!
Make it yours: The masala seasoning is mild, but if you prefer a lighter curry flavour, reduce the amount to taste.
